newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hong Kong-Australia travel seen made easier.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hong Kong-Australia travel seen made easier.

text.p: The Australian government was working on making travel to Australia easier for Hong Kong passport holders, Hong Kong Chief Secretary Anson Chan said on Friday.

"I believe that the government has under consideration certain arrangements that will make the visa application and obtaining the necessary visa even easier," Chan told reporters after meeting with Australia's Prime Minister John Howard.
Chan said she had discussed with Howard the issue of visa-free access for Hong Kong passport holders after China resumes control of the British colony in July 1997.
She noted about 80,000 people from Hong Kong were now residents in Australia and 12,000 students were studying here.
"Given our increasingly strong ties it is in both our interest that travel between Australia and Hong Kong should be made flexible and easy," she added.
